name: kadar
description: Kadar — fast image viewer, image/video optimizer, screenshot and screen recorder for macOS

scripts.build: scripts/build-ffmpeg.sh && npm run check && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" tauri build
scripts.check: tsc && vitest run && node scripts/check-docs.mjs && cd src-tauri && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo clippy --quiet --all-targets -- -D warnings && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo test --quiet
